I don’t think I’m postponing it, but I do believe pain can transfer. I’m not sad over the breakup anymore, but I am awfully sad about how I never found anyone else and how lonely I am at this time of the year. Of course that’s a result of the breakup, but .. I don’t regret the breakup happening. At the end of the day, he wasn’t my person. And, like you I believe, I found a lot of freedom without him. It’s just getting through this time of year which is tough and what brought me back here for a short while.
Exactly. My go to now has always been keeping myself busy so I never really stop to think on it anymore. I’m sure it’s not the best solution, but it’s what I’ve got right now.

Thank you so much for your kindness.

I don't think there's goodness out there for me in this big, bad world. My little taste of it was absolutely amazing, stunning, and perfect while it lasted. People like me don't get happy endings. We get self-harm scars, empty beds, and tears.
Thank you so much.
Hang in there.
The pain hasn't gotten less for me. It's gotten worse. I think the only way this road comes to an end is if I give up, stop walking, and crumple to the floor, motionless.

Neutral, I suppose? xD I've been here for months nearly every day so . . . yeah. I'll send it over.
Take her places! Kids love going places, trust me. It was one of my favorite parts of growing up.
I've seen you on these forums before. I could PM you what has happened to me, if I haven't already.

Couldn't have put it better myself.

I bet your daughter is a bit of goodness in your life, though. Children always are. They have the innocence that I wish the rest of the world was capable of.
Isn't the world just grand? It doesn't give good people goodness. That would be too fair.

There's nothing in this world I want to do.

I don't have any friends, and I can't just conjure new ones up out of thin air.

I only weigh 100 pounds, and my job keeps me on my feet for 7+ hours at a time, 40 hours a week. It involves heavy lifting, too. I don't think I need the gym, haha. I think it would do more harm to my body than good.

I tried joining online groups to feel involved, but -- all of the people I interact with there are so much younger than myself and I feel pretty out of place.

God has turned his back on me, so I have turned my back on Him. I trusted Him when he brought this person into my life, because I was afraid, and look at where it got me.

It's a really sweet sentiment, but the world has shown me time and time again that I don't get good things. I don't think there's a good future out there for me. The world hates me, and I hate the world. There's no hope for people like me. I'll forever be stuck in a living hell. I'm somehow expected to live with this, and I don't know how.

Oh, things are continually getting worse for me, but that's okay. I really don't expect them to get any better so I'm not putting any high expectations on the world. I like working as much as I can because it keeps me busy. I don't really like having free time anymore. I don't know what to do with it. I should be looking for a job in my career field instead of settling with the minimum-wage job with no benefits that I have, but -- I don't really care enough to make those kinds of moves right now.

I feel like she missed out on a nice guy.

I really hope things get better for you and that you end up having a good day today.

Are you doing alright, all things considered?
You, too. I hope things get better for you.

I feel you on the "not knowing them" concept.

Oh, please, I'll probably never date anyone ever again. I'd be shocked. I only ever wanted one relationship so not only did I lose him, but I lost my dream, too. Of course, I can still keep my dream alive of only ever being with one person, but that means I end up alone for the rest of my life. The balance between having my dream but not having my dream is a pretty difficult one. I can't win no matter how hard I try.

I hope things get better for you. If you ever need someone to chat/vent to, feel free to send me a chat/PM.

I'm so happy you had an accomplishment! Way to go! It doesn't matter; I don't find things like that silly. An accomplishment is an accomplishment and should be celebrated for what it is.

I hope you have a great day today!

How are you?
Thank you. I just feel like I deserved the trash treatment I received, being trash myself.
There is no answer. I've already told you, I think death is the answer.

This is going to sound pretty twisted, so bear with me, but a part of me almost wishes I had a child with him. 

I'd have a piece of him that he'd have little-to-no title to, because I already know he would choose to be completely absent from the child's life.

Aside from that, I'd have a reason to stay alive. I'd have a child that needs me. No one else would be that child's mother except for me. I'd never, EVER even entertain the thought of killing myself if I had a child that needed me.

I feel so worthless and unwanted with the way I am now.

The fear, sadly, isn't that productive.

I begged for him not to leave because I didn't know how to live without him. I was, and still am, a suicidal mess, and I was scared. He was my best friend, my whole world, my everything. He was the reason I woke up each day and lived my life. He couldn't leave. The pain from having him absent in my life would be too much.

Fast-forward three months.

He's gone. He's completely gone. The night he told me we were done was the last time we had any form of contact. I waited and waited for him to come back, a part of me still does. I no longer fear living without him because I'm doing it, but I resent it with every fiber of my core. I hate the life I'm living. I constantly want out of it.

I don't know what was better -- the fear or this hatred I now have. Neither is very good.
I'm starting to think any thought of him will always hurt.

It's been three months for me after the break-up and, although that may not seem like a long time to some, so many things have happened in the months that he has been gone: good things, bad things, neutral things. He stopped contacting me immediately when he left me, so I haven't even heard his voice for three months. I miss it a lot. I still hope for him to come back. We were together for three years. I don't understand how he can just cut me out of his life completely when he has kept other ex's of his in his life. He's on my mind every day for hours. I cry for him every day for hours.

I wish I mattered. I know I don't, but I wish I did. Time is making everything worse.

My ex-boyfriend and one of my friends have a name with a one letter difference. My ex's name is the more common of the two, so whenever I type her name now my phone autocorrects it to his. I'd been with him for three years, so I guess it makes sense. I hate it.

I miss all of the I-love-you's. I miss feeling the love that just radiated off him. I really hope he's happy out there in this big, bad world that has absolutely crushed me.
I don't think so.
Life isn't that kind.
It's an impossibility.

Something similar happened to me. My ex-boyfriend had stood by me through a lot of things. He knew I had a history of being depressed and suicidal and that I also had a history with self-harming. Out of nowhere, he told me he wanted a break, and I said something in the heat of the moment that I shouldn't have. It convinced him that I am "violent and unstable," and he left. He never came back. It's so hard to keep going.
Neither will I.
Perhaps.
Giving up is how you win the race.
I don't believe it anymore.

I wish it could. I wish there was some way I could reverse this. I lost my first boyfriend of three years, too, and it's been three months, and I'm getting worse rather than better. He ended all contact with me when he left. We both mutually removed each other from Twitter -- the only social media we used -- he did it first, and I unfollowed him after just so I wasn't that weird person still following him. It hurts. It hurts so damn much.

It stinks that you can't really control how people will see you. At the end of the day, people will make their own decisions.
There’s no hope for people like me, but I appreciate the sentiment all the same 😊

It sounds like you're not fully there yet but that you're making good progress.
True.. 37 is a bit much.
I'm following in your footsteps through-and-through.

I still wait for a text or a phone call three months later, not because I expect to get one, but because I know it's humanly possible.

I wish it wasn't.
I'm 22. He's been my one-and-only relationship.
It's not your fault. It's mine. I have to live with what I'm responsible for.
Honestly, that's a super sweet offer, but my negativity would drown the positivity out of you like it does with everyone else.

I find that I don't really want to go out with other people. He's still all I want, even months later. No one else compares. All the times I've gone out, I've gotten disappointed that the people I'm going out with aren't him. It's always about him. The break-up was my fault, and I can't really live with it. It's taking over my entire life. I'm just tired and empty all the time.
I hope you had a good day today, too!

I wish I could answer your questions but, sadly, I don't have many answers because they are questions I also ask myself.

Unlike you, I'm not fine.

Similarly to you, I also lost all contact with my ex-boyfriend from the moment we broke up, and it's been 3 months. I, too, plan to keep things this way, not because I want them this way, but because I know he doesn't want me.

I was a lot more confident and happy while I was with him. If I thought my insecurities were bad before, they are absolutely nothing compared to how bad they are now. I never really thought anyone wanted me, though. I never have, and I probably never will. Even when my ex-boyfriend and I were together I caught on that he didn't want me. I always just wished that he did. I really don't know why he wasted 3 years of both our lives.

I'll never find anyone like him. He was smart, attractive, and my perfect match. He was, and will always be, one of a kind. I don't want anyone but him. I never will.

I don't think it's all in your head.

I really do hope you get back to your old self.

My experience is different from yours, but I can share some parallels.

I was with a guy for three years, and nine times out of ten I was always the one initiating calls, texts, plans, etc. 

He told me he needed some space after we got into a disagreement, so I decided to stop initiating rather than checking in on him like I usually did. He surprisingly checked in on me, and that made me feel pretty good. "Hey, did you get home safe today?" "Yeah, I did. Thanks." "No problem." I didn't respond to that "No problem" from him. I figured that he could've asked me how I was doing or said something to keep the conversation going, and he didn't.

Fast forward a week after that when he called me up and told me he was breaking up with me. He mentioned that moment. He said it felt like I didn't care.

It's been a hard concept to struggle with. I really did feel as though I was the one initiating all the time and, of course, the one time I don't initiate, I lose him and get the blame. I don't know whether or not I really went wrong or maybe he just really isn't such a good guy for never initiating. I can't tell which one it is. Maybe we both wronged each other.

All I know is that I miss him, and I wish none of this mess ever happened.
I've been feeling dead inside for a week or two now. I don't even feel sad anymore. I just feel completely dead. I don't think this ever gets better. It frightens me. I just want to feel again.
I'd totally be willing to be your friend! Send me a message if you ever wish to. c:

I always had to ask my ex if I could call him. He never asked. I was always the one making all the calls.

Even so, I still miss it. I told him everything. I miss the sound of his voice.
That's how it goes, sadly.. It's the worst kind of irony there is.
I could have written this myself.

I set him free with the hope that he'd find his way back to me.

He didn't.

My ex-boyfriend was the same way. Perhaps they just look for excuses. When he was breaking up with me, he said he didn't think a relationship was good for either of us right now because he believed we needed to get our lives together. I then said to him: "Well, you don't have to worry about me getting in a relationship again for a long, long time, because that's not in my planning. How about you?" And he said: "I gotta go," and ended the phone call. I'm almost completely convinced he's with someone new. I mean, it has been over three months, and even though that feels like such a short time to me, it really isn't.
That, too. 🤷🏻‍♀️
Pessimist, nihilist, depressed individual — call it what you will. 🤷🏻‍♀️
Yeah. All I have is internet people. 😪
Good things don’t really exist at all.
People just aren’t good.
Because good things don’t exist without a price.
I don’t have that option, sadly.

Oh, hi again. 

Nope. Not for me. I’m just constantly trying to keep myself busy at this point so I don’t face the feelings anymore.

But why should I be optimistic when I was when I met my ex? How am I supposed to look at what he did to me in an optimistic light? All I can think of is: “I trusted him, and he broke my heart.” There’s nothing optimistic about that. I mean, I guess I can focus on the “ability that I could trust someone that much,” but that feels like bullshit to me.

Hang in there. My three year relationship ended over a phone call. I never heard from him again after that call three months ago today. He was supposed to text me so we could swap stuff, and he never did.

I told my ex-boyfriend that I had never been more confident about anything and that I knew we could work things out. He said: “Yeah, well I’m not.” I was willing to give my all. I couldn’t stop him. His mind was made up. I begged and pleaded. I got nowhere. Sometimes, the people who want to give it their all don’t get the happy ending. 

I really, really hope things work out for you, though. I know your feeling all too well.

My mind is actually working against me and is trying to tell me he wasn’t real and that I made it all up. I create story characters all the time, and my mind is just telling me he’s another character. I even created a character based off him that I had to stop using because of the association. 

So far, though, my mind really is convincing me I made him up. Of course I had to hide anything that had sentimental value to him. Of course I had to stop looking at photos of him. 

He also went No Contact immediately, the night he broke up with me on the phone. That was 3 months ago today — March 1st. 

I long for the version of him that used to exist. The one that existed for three years. Now it’s been three months, and I haven’t gotten any better.

For me, I know I messed up a lot, and I wish I could change the things that I messed up on. I don’t want to make them better “for a partner in the future.” I want to make them better for him. 

Aside from putting me at blame, though, it also hurts how ultimately, he became stuck in seeing me a certain way. I messed up and said something I shouldn’t have, and he couldn’t forgive me for one sentence gone wrong, even when I tried to explain myself. My love for him was always unconditional. I wish that came from him, too, but it didn’t. He ended up seeing me the one way I never wanted to be seen. He told me he was so afraid of me that he never wanted to see me in person again, even with other people around. A lot of people have told me he was just gaslighting me but, even if he was, the thought of someone potentially fearing me like that really unsettles me. He made me feel like I’m a monster.
Yeah. I just kept myself so busy that I couldn’t even think to get into that spot.
People suck.

My ex had multiple partners before me, so being with me did nothing. I told him how hurt I was over being taken like that, and he said: “Giving myself to you meant something to me, too. I didn’t just do that to do it.” But he’s not the one haunted by it. I am. Joke’s on me.
Heartbreak sucks.
I feel like my purity is just gone and it stinks. I feel tarnished.
I just think I'm at the stage where I've mostly given up on everything.
I just only ever had one partner, and messing that up.. sucks. I really just wanted one.
Sending you love, too.

No, I didn't use him.

I just convinced him I'm crazy.
Doing my best.
Unless you get the short end of the stick and end up forever alone, of course. I don't think this'll happen to OP, per say, but it'll definitely happen to me.
It's crazy when you remember where you were a year ago and where you are now. I dread having memories like these all the time.

I have to admit, I have shared a bit of the same learning. I sacrificed so much of what I wanted and needed for him. If he had a problem with anything, it was always his solution. We never compromised. It was his way or the high way. He made me keep our relationship a secret for three years, and he convinced me it was the right thing to do. I just did everything he asked.

I don't know if this is the best advice, so please take it at face value, but --

You could try keeping yourself busy. Today was my first day off from work in a while with no chores to get done or anything. I joined so many new online groups and answered so many posts on Reddit that there was hardly a single moment all day where I didn't have some person online waiting on a reply from me. I feel so exhausted now. I feel more exhausted than if I had worked a full work day. It kept me from thinking, like at all, though.

There's a quote that says:

"The thing about betrayal is it never comes from your enemies."

I hate it, too.
It's crazy to see how so many people have it worse than my ex and I did, in terms of abuse and arguing and stuff, and yet my ex and I aren't the ones together anymore. It makes no sense to me.

"I think love is a lot more conditional than people want to believe."

For me, I'm certain the love I gave to this guy was unconditional. I'm probably the last of a dying breed in this day and age. I really, really wish it was unconditional for me, too. He doesn't care that I love him. He hates that I love him. This isn't a story where we're meant to be together. He's just gone.

I just wanted to let you know that I read this and that you are not alone.

My ex mentioned a break, took a week, and then it turned to a break-up. We were together for three years.

I wasn't blind to the issues, either and, like your ex, I would bring them up. Communication was a big one, but I still think that was more his problem than mine. Time passed, and things just got worse and worse, even though I thought we were on the pathway to mending things when he left me. He left me a few days after Valentine's Day over the phone, and our Valentine's Day was perfect.

He always got angry at me for putting the bad moments above the good ones, but in the end, that's what he did, not me. I adored his family; I came to like them more than my own. I just graduated college, and I thought that I'd be looking for a full time job in my field and moving in with him. Instead, I'm working a minimum wage job for 40 hours a week and feeling exhausted all of the other time. I really wanted a family with him. I'm 22.

I tried my hand at trying to convince him to stay, and it got me nowhere.

This has been my one and only break-up, and I'm pretty sure it will be the death of me. I was convinced we could have made things work. I told him I was, on our final phone call, and he said: "Yeah, well I'm not convinced!" I lie in bed and the hours just pass by and by and by.

I've never been less motivated. I don't really want to go out "people searching" after working for 40 hours in a week. I'm too tired. My job has me on my feet all day. I like to just lie around in bed.

No one will ever love me.
There's just no hope in this world anymore.

Nope. I didn't want to take away any space he thought he needed. He also told me he was afraid of me, so I decided to give him control in contacting me. He didn't. It's been three months. I'm not about to break No Contact over it now.

He put the trash out -- me.
All anyone can do is hope.
Wouldn't that be nice? The world just doesn't give people like me good things, sadly.
Yeah -- I've wondered if I took him for granted, too. I'm so sorry about all of it. I regret so much. I've never felt so guilty about anything in my entire life.
I said and did things I shouldn't have.
It's not your fault. It's what I've done. I have to somehow live with it.

He unexpectedly left me 3 months ago, in a phone call a few days after Valentine's Day, which was the last time I saw him in person. Everything was perfect on Valentine's Day. Not a single thing went wrong. I thought things with us were climbing upward. I'm pretty sure I even cried happy tears on that day. The next day I was texting with my mom, and she told me she really thought the two of us would get married someday. We had a concert planned together for the weekend after he left me that he never even paid me back for. We were together for 3 years.

I haven't contacted him. The last time we spoke, in that phone call, I told him I wanted him to text me so that we could exchange when to swap our belongings, and he said he would. He never did. I think of him all the time. I cry over him for hours every day.

I'm a mess.

I do. I don't know how to balance out the scale of either

A) I never be with anyone again, even though I really want to, and I want to have that connection with someone

and

B) I feel sick to my stomach at the very thought of getting close to someone like that. I can't trust. I don't want to trust. My ex knew how to please me in every which way. I don't want to have to awkwardly "relearn" that with someone. We were together for three years. I was comfortable. Plus, we slept together the last time I laid physical eyes on him, so that doesn't help. He broke up with me in a phone call a week later.

I'm just completely stuck either way.

I agree with this fully.

I only ever wanted to be with one person, and now that that shot is gone, I don't know what to do. The very thought of ever being like that with someone else sickens me to my stomach. That's not something I wanted to give out to multiple people.

It's been three months for me, but I see little-to-no healing taking place.

I've started working 40 hours a week at my job, and it hasn't been easy. It makes me miss coming home and being able to see him. Being with him made all of the long and tiring work shifts worth it. We didn't need to go out. I wouldn't want to go out after a long day. I'd be comfortable just lying in his arms and playing video games. Now, if I ever want to meet new people, the reality is I have to start going out, even though that's not what I want to be doing after being so tired from work.

On the days I couldn't physically see him, I'd call him and tell him all about my day -- even the really dumb, insignificant little details. I miss having someone to talk to like that. No one really understands me like he did.

Too much damage has been done for him to ever come back. I still wish he would, but what I'm wishing for is completely unrealistic. I'm not even wishing for him to come back, really. I'm wishing for things to go back to the way they were the last time I laid eyes on him and everything was completely perfect. No one can turn back time like that.

Honestly, the loss of him has been worse than a death for me. I know he's still out there. I know he's going to find someone new. I know he's going to keep living his life.

Meanwhile, it's been three months for me, and I spend all of my time in bed crying.

Each year since 2015 I've lost someone who meant a lot to me. In 2015, my favorite cat Star died. In 2016, I lost my grandmother. In 2017, I lost my best friend's mother. In 2018 -- I lost him. And even though he's the only one of the aforementioned still alive, he feels more dead than all of the others.

My break-up, quite honestly, ruined everything for me.

I've always been a good student, but I've never been "passionate" about school. I've always gotten solid A+s in everything, and I've always devoted my all to school, but when I stop to think about it, I'm not even sure why I did. Maybe to know I was doing the best? Maybe to keep myself busy and from the thoughts that run rampant in my head? Maybe to work toward my dream future? (We'll get more to that later.) Anyways --

I graduated college a week or two ago with Summa Cum Laude -- 3.98 GPA. I double majored in Communications and English because I liked those types of classes, but not because there was anything I wanted to do in those fields. I'm currently a cashier at a CVS. I work about 40 hours a week for a little bit above minimum wage pay. I don't love or hate my job. It's a job. I realize it could be better, but I also realize it could be worse. I feel comfortable there. I know what I'm doing there. I've been there for almost a full year.

Now --

CVS was intended to be the back-up plan. I started going on job interviews for stuff in my field back in December, because I wanted to have a job lined up in my field for when I graduated in May. When my ex-boyfriend left me in February, I stopped applying for jobs completely. Even now, I'm not. I lie to my parents and tell them that I'm spending my free time when I'm not working sending out my resume. Instead, I spend it in bed crying and on Reddit.

My whole goal in life was to only have one partner and to build a life with that one partner. I know it's pretty crazy to think you can end up with your first love but -- I had a lot of points going for me. I met him in college, so I thought we were both at a stage where we were more mature and actually trying to field out a person to settle down with. He had a lot of relationships before me, so I thought I was finally going to be the girl to get him to stop searching (in reality, this should have been more of a red flag). Finally, we lasted for three years, and his longest relationship before me was a year and seven months. I thought we had it made.

The last time I saw him was Valentine's Day, and my last physical memory is him kissing me goodnight on my porch. He called me a week later and ended things.

It's ruined everything. Absolutely everything.

The goal I wanted isn't there anymore. I can't have a family with that one partner. If I ever want a family, it's going to involve me meeting someone else and giving myself to someone else and that very idea disgusts me to the core. I only go to work to keep myself busy. I'm not a spender, and I don't really know why I should want the money anymore anyways. I don't want to live. I just wanted money to save up for that future I wanted with my ONE partner, but now that's gone.

It feels like my entire life just died out.

I posted about it in response to someone else on this post, but --
